what_this_is: The crates scripts/local_gate.sh's trust-verified-lane leg runs through `targo trust check --allow-l0-gaps --locked -j 4 -p <crate> --lib`, and the per-crate floor scripts/check_trust_verified_lane.py holds each to. A crate here must report ZERO failed obligations; `proved_floor` is 80% of the proved count measured below, rounded down, so verifier nondeterminism (serde-derived rows flip proved<->unknown<->timeout between runs on a loaded box) does not turn the leg red while a real loss does. Unknown rows never count toward a floor. Adding a crate or raising a floor is a reviewed edit; lowering one must say why in `history`.
measured_with: targo 1.99.0-dev (321aaeda7 2026-09-17), trustc from the aterm package store (trust/9192), host aarch64-apple-darwin, load 15-25
